title: Channel check: Q4 rack deliveries slip into 2027 at two clouds
text:
SYNTHETIC CHANNEL CHECK — FICTIONAL VENDOR REPORT FOR A DEMO SCENARIO. NOT A CLAIM ABOUT REAL COMPANIES.

Supply Chain Signals (fictional) | Q4 2026 rack delivery check | Interviews October 9–12, 2026

Sample: 6 respondents — 3 ODM/OEM supply managers, 2 power equipment vendors, 1 hyperscaler data center planner.
1. Two of the three ODM/OEM respondents said two of the four largest US clouds asked them in the past three weeks to move part of their Q4 2026 rack-scale deliveries into Q1 2027.
2. The reason given was late utility interconnects and transformers at new campuses; both power vendors confirmed delays at two campuses.
3. The ODMs put the shifted volume at roughly $12–15bn of system value, about 70% of it NVIDIA rack-scale systems and under 5% AMD. They described the orders as deferred, not cancelled.
4. The hyperscaler planner said accelerator systems are paid for on delivery and acceptance, so a slip moves that spending out of calendar 2026 and into 2027.
Supply Chain Signals view: calendar 2026 accelerator spending at the largest clouds lands below plans; 2027 is higher by about the same amount.
